headline: AI jitters drag stocks before Nvidia; the beat lands after the bell
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.03% to its lowest close since late July and the Dow lost about 849 points, with decliners outnumbering advancers nearly 3 to 1. After the close Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8B (+103% y/y) and guided to about $130B for next quarter; shares traded about 4.4% higher after hours.

history.note: Daily closes. S&P 500 close for Nov 12 was not captured in the sources, so that point is left as a gap. Nov 13 closes are derived from the Nov 16 close minus Schwab's reported Nov 16 change.

watchlist.note: Fiscal Q3 after the close: revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), data center $107.6B (+110%), Q4 guide ≈ $130B. First report since Jensen Huang resigned; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

watchlist.note: Closed up 2.46% on a day the S&P 500 fell 1%; Reddit chatter on AVGO, AMD and MU skewed bullish.

thesis: Revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y) and a ≈$130B next-quarter guide, both above Street expectations.
Stock went into the print ≈36% below its Oct 6 peak at a 19.7 P/E, so the beat lands on a reset valuation.
Most-discussed ticker on Stocktwits (≈68.8K mentions) and retail dip-buyers were already returning.
picks.risks: Leadership turmoil after the CEO's resignation, a California AG investigation, and three analyst downgrades last week. After-hours gains can fade at the open.

thesis: Closed +2.46% while the S&P 500 fell 1.03% — the kind of strength that holds up on a risk-off day.
Nvidia's guide supports the AI-capex spending Broadcom also sells into; Schwab tracks capex as the first signpost of the AI cycle.
Reddit sentiment on AVGO skewed bullish, while the crowd stayed split on NVDA itself.
picks.risks: Semis are swinging hard: the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 5.28% on Monday. Ten-year yields at 5.14% pressure richly valued growth stocks.

thesis: Beat on earnings and revenue, Entertainment revenue +17% y/y, and guidance above expectations.
Sold off ≈2% early despite the beat, which creates a possible entry for a stock that doesn't trade on AI headlines.
Analysts lean Moderate Buy with an average target of $127.39; beta of 0.95 is lower than the AI leaders'.
picks.risks: Tuesday's close wasn't captured — check the live price first. Hot inflation (October PPI +6.5% y/y) and Fed officials openly discussing rate hikes weigh on consumer spending.

sentiment.read: NVDA leads by a wide margin with ≈68.8K mentions; Bitcoin mentions jumped 43% in a day.
Dip-buyers returned to Nvidia; retail bought ≈$111M of NVDA in the first half hour on Nov 12, the stock's biggest opening bid on record.
Only 19% of surveyed Schwab retail clients were bullish on equities for November (17% in October).
Leadership is rotating unusually fast; Energy was the best-performing sector over the trailing 12 months and Communication Services the worst.

macroNotes.t: October retail sales rose 0.2% vs. 0.3% expected; ex-autos rose 0.6% vs. 0.1%.
October PPI rose 6.5% year over year, the sharpest annual increase since November 2022.
Several Fed officials signalled openness to a more aggressive path of rate hikes.
